actions.keep: Retain as an independently reachable product surface.
actions.shrink: Retain the use case while reducing navigation, controls, or presentation state.
actions.merge: Move the use case into the named replacement surface without duplicating its data owner.
actions.delete: Remove the route or surface after the named replacement is reachable and verified.
